summary: Keep retained unadmitted records from displacing a valid pairing challenge.

replay.detail: Existing claims and operation receipts retain their interpretation.

schema.detail: Completion uses the existing client operation receipt and writer transaction.

compatibility.detail: Pairing selects an admitted challenge before canonical ordering and atomically consumes it once. Retained unadmitted begin or completion records cannot shadow a valid challenge.

downtime.detail: The correction applies when the daemon accepts a pairing completion.

manual.detail: Existing device pairing steps remain valid.

recovery.detail: Retry completion with the current pairing challenge or request a new challenge after expiry.
